region.name: Arabian Sea
region.selection_rationale: Karnataka coastal model applied to Arabian Sea catch; geographic transfer.
region.status: recalculated; historical sensitivity bounds invalidated and require reassessment

paper.authors: K. S. Mohamed; P. U. Zacharia; C. Muthiah; K. P. Abdurahiman; T. H. Nayak
paper.title: Trophic Modelling of the Arabian Sea Ecosystem off Karnataka and Simulation of Fishery Yields
paper.geometry_method: Published27,000 km2 shelf footprint and source study-area figure checked against target boundary; approximate area fit, no invented digital study polygon
paper.full_model_loadable: Canonical JSON loaded and group SPPR executed; source-rounded zero-BA model has balance warnings. Native EwE database not tested.
paper.quality_rationale: 24 source groups;27,000 km2 Karnataka shelf.93 published B/PB/QB/EE cells,24 landings totals and528 balanced-diet cells reconciled. Source-stated zero BA adopted; GE/TE/With Egestion executed with WARN, no negative matrix entries. Existing catalog numeric scores retained without rescoring.
paper.extraction_readiness: Source reconciliation completed2026-09-30; zero BA adopted and dependent results refreshed
paper.download_attempt_summary: 5 actual retrieval requests logged in this project.
paper.recommendation: Best documented Arabian Sea Ecopath parameterization located; geographically partial.
paper.geometry_note: A approximately0.65–0.69%; B approximately95–100%. Source printed p.8/PDF18; target WGS84 geodesic area3,931,779.8km2. Coordinate rectangle used only as containment check.
paper.provenance: Inherited from final all-84 catalog; original bibliographic and footprint claims retained
paper.legacy_title: Trophic modelling of the Arabian Sea ecosystem off Karnataka and adjacent waters
paper.correction_notes: 2008 publication retained under legacy ARAB-2005 ID.2026-09-30 source/mapping validation adopted explicit zero BA; source balance WARN retained.
paper.coverage_note: Subregional coastal transfer; source study covers approximately0.65–0.69% of LME032.

model.selection_rationale: Karnataka coastal model applied to Arabian Sea catch; geographic transfer.
model.availability: Canonical JSON and fresh group-SPPR source workbook; full GE/TE/With Egestion returns retained
model.coverage_note: Karnataka shelf model; approximate LME overlap A0.65–0.69%,B95–100%. Source zero BA adopted; balance WARN and TE near-singular marine-mammal group retained.
